description: This file defines an AuthProvider class that manages user authentication state, including login, registration, persistence, and logout functionalities. It interacts with shared preferences for local storage and uses AppUser model for user data representation.

classes.name: AuthProvider
classes.description: A provider class that manages authentication state, including login, registration, and user persistence.

methods.name: loadPersistedUser
methods.description: Loads user data from shared preferences if available and updates the state.

methods.name: persistUser
methods.description: Stores the user data in shared preferences.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Simulates a user login process, updates user state, and persists the user data.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Simulates user registration, updates user state, and persists the user data.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Clears user data from shared preferences and resets the user state.
